goodsAndServices: IC 009: Downloadable artificial intelligence software for task automation and workflow management; Downloadable artificial intelligence software for use in data analytics; Downloadable computer software platforms for artificial intelligence workflows; Downloadable artificial intelligence software for agent-based control of computer systems.

IC 042: Platform as a service (PaaS) featuring computer software platforms for artificial intelligence-based task automation and workflow management; Software as a service (SaaS) services featuring software for use in managing and automating business processes through artificial intelligence; Software as a service (SaaS) services featuring software for use in managing computer-based information systems with artificial intelligence capabilities; Cloud computing services, namely, cloud computing featuring software for use in developing, configuring, customizing and deploying artificial intelligence applications; Application monitoring and management for others in the nature of a computer monitoring service which tracks artificial intelligence software performance, performs periodic maintenance and provides reports and alerts concerning such performance; Providing temporary use of on-line non-downloadable artificial intelligence software to others for managing, tracking, analyzing, and reporting data across industries including healthcare, finance, and logistics; Consulting services in the fields of artificial intelligence implementation and integration; Providing information in the field of artificial intelligence technology; Computer programming services for others, namely, designing, developing, customizing, testing, implementing and maintaining artificial intelligence software systems for others; Computer programming services for others, namely, designing, developing, customizing, testing, implementing and maintaining agent-based artificial intelligence software systems for others; Information technology consulting services, namely, artificial intelligence integration services for enterprise clients.
